title: Character roster: rig, retarget, and in-app selection
summary: Build the v1 avatar as a curated roster of pre-made, rigged, semi-photorealistic 1:12 characters (ADR-0006, AUTH #020). Each shares the GJ humanoid skeleton and retargets the shared animation/traversal set; the player selects one; the two cosmetic IAP SKUs reskin it. No face/body capture, no biometric processing.

acceptance_tests.test: A roster of at least 6 rigged, semi-photorealistic 1:12 characters loads in Unity 6, each retargeting the shared GJ humanoid skeleton and animation/traversal set with no manual per-character fixes (bone count, T-pose, eye height, scale validated).
In-app character selection: the chosen character carries into play and the diorama; the cosmetic IAP SKUs (outfit pack, realism+ materials) preview and apply on the selected character.
No face or body capture path exists and no biometric data is collected (verifies AUTH #020 / SECURITY_CHECKLIST §5 is v1-N/A).
A tester picks a character and it moves identically well across five environments.

history.event: created by the Coordinator as the ADR-0006 v1 avatar follow-up (AUTH #020): replaces the face-capture avatar milestone with a curated character roster.
